summary.intent: Close 29 spec-drift and guard findings in the callisto repo via small PRs: one spec-wording PR in parallel, then seven sequential code PRs, driven by a multi-agent workflow.
summary.outcome: The workflow only partly completed. The spec branch was pushed but no PR was opened, and cluster 1 (duration, token scrub, git failure) was implemented and verified. The assistant then reviewed the staged diff, trimmed one over-long doc comment and made the signed commit. Cluster 2 (PyPI publish) did not start because the worktree was dirty, and push and PR creation for cluster 1 are still pending.

repo: Specs live in docs/specs/*.json (release, cli, versioning, workspace). Criteria are IDs like REL-PUB-13 and VER-READ-02, and they can drift from the code.
The repo rule limits doc comments to a certain length, and one comment was trimmed to comply.
Changesets in .changeset/*.md are required for code changes but not for docs-only or comment-only changes.
docs/errors.md only needs updating when a new error code is added.
Verification is `cargo nextest`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, and `just ci`.

Three callisto-cli e2e tests fail in the sandbox because they need network access to registry.npmjs.org, index.crates.io and github.com: native_resolution_e2e_tests (two) and lifecycle_e2e_tests test_full_polyglot_workspace_release_lifecycle. They were not confirmed to also fail on origin/main.
Commits must be GPG-signed, and PRs are opened through a bot token flow.

code.finding: parse_duration sliced with split_at(len-1), which panics or misparses on multi-byte input. It now uses split_at_checked, so "5é" and "é" return None.

remove_unrelated_cargo_registry_tokens now collects token names case-insensitively from both the parent environment and the variables already set on the child command (get_envs). All run routes call this one function after the child's variables are set.

GitAccess::commits_since returns an empty list only when HEAD is unborn, detected with `git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD` exiting 1. `HEAD^{commit}` was rejected because it also exits 1 for a missing HEAD object and would hide a damaged repository.
aggregate() now propagates an inference error instead of filing a PreMajorInferenceInert warning. That diagnostic is now documented as not emitted and kept for wire compatibility.

workflow: Parallel workflow agents share one worktree, so a later agent that finds uncommitted changes from an earlier one stops, and sequential clusters block on each other.

Sandbox restrictions block gpg access to ~/.gnupg (keyboxd), `.git/config` writes, network fetches, and gh PR creation with the user's own credentials. Agents stalled on these instead of bypassing them.
Reviewing staged diffs before committing under the user's name caught a style violation.

friction: gh refused to open the spec PR because it could not mint an orin-dx-pr-bot token (age/keychain decrypt failed).
The spec PR body was deleted after the failed attempt and needs rewriting.
The sandbox blocked gpg, so the agent could not make the signed commit for cluster 1 and left the changes staged.
Cluster 2 (C2-pypi-publish) stopped because cluster 1's uncommitted changes were still in the shared worktree, so REL-PUB-09 and related findings were not started.
Network denials in the sandbox broke the first fetch and three CLI e2e tests, and the agent had to retry some calls with the sandbox disabled.
The branch name already existed locally, and the sandbox could not write .git/config for upstream tracking, so the agent switched to the existing branch instead of creating it.
open_items: Open the spec PR from the pushed branch docs/spec-drift-corrections with: gh pr create --base main --head docs/spec-drift-corrections --title "docs(specs): correct criteria that drifted from the code". The body needs rewriting, describing what changed and how it was verified, with no session links.
Push fix/duration-token-scrub-git-failure and open its PR, since only the signed commit was made.
Re-run the remaining clusters, starting with C2-pypi-publish (branch fix/pypi-confirmation-window-and-digest), now that the worktree can be clean, then the later sequential code PRs.
Confirm that the 3 failing CLI e2e tests also fail on origin/main, and run `just ci`, which was not run.
Switch the worktree back to a detached origin/main after pushing cluster 1.
